Go get Fin Gleam off the coast of Anvil as soon as you can. Right after you get out of the tutorial dungeon that should be your first destination.

Don't forget you can fast travel to any of the major cities immediately, so just pop over to Anvil, head for the little island due west of the town entrance just off the coast right by where it says "Anvil" on the map, hop into the water off the western side of the island, and nab it from the skeleton near the rocks.

It's easy to find and it's not really a dangerous trip. The worst you'll have to deal with is likely a few mud crabs, and they are easily avoided if you're careful.

It's super useful throughout the whole game as it has water breathing, detect life, and night eye. Plus it's got armor stats similar to a Glass Helm. It is hands down the best item you can get right away in the game and essential to any starting character.

It's also not great to wear all the time, unless you want to play the entire game with that blue tint over it. I usually slot it in a hot key so I can take it on and off easily, as it is very useful in a lot of situations.

I love how these items are static in the world and not levelled. Oblivion is much more easy to break and abuse, but I have much fonder memories of it as well. Maybe it's nostalgia, though. I don't think I could ever really go back and play it again because the mechanics are so dated.
